scrape-execution.custom-headers.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: `headers` on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc), at most 32 lower-cased RFC 7230 names with values of at most 4096 characters; user-agent, sec-ch-*, sec-fetch-*, authorization, proxy-authorization, cookie and the transport headers are refused by name with HTTP 400. The http lane sends them to the requested origin after the identity and withholds them from a cross-origin hop (custom_headers_withheld); the browser lane sends them with the document and its same-origin requests, records a server redirect that carried them on (custom_headers_forwarded), and its signed sentHeaders carry them as sent. Both lanes record request_headers_added; robots.txt gets the identity alone; a request with headers skips the vendor rungs (ladder_channels_filtered). Live: httpbin echoes X-Test and Accept-Language beside the declared User-Agent, a User-Agent header is HTTP 400 naming it, and scrapethissite's header gotcha answers 200 with the header and 400 without (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md A, B, C). Tests: contracts api.test.ts, bench pageOptions.test.ts, api executionOptions.test.ts, mcp tools.test.ts, contracts firecrawl.test.ts.

scrape-execution.mobile-emulation.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: `mobile` on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc), refused with research mode. A second declared identity, Android 14 Pixel 7 Chrome with the same major, sec-ch-ua-mobile ?1, platform Android, a 412x915 touch viewport at 2.625, passing identityBundleIssues and checkIdentityHonesty; the http lane sends it and evaluates robots.txt against it (identity_sent.device), the browser lane opens the mobile fingerprint, declares it (identity_declared), sets Chromium's user-agent metadata so its own hints and navigator.userAgentData agree, and its compliance record carries the mobile User-Agent and hints as sent (schemaVersion 2 has no device field). Live: Wikipedia Web_scraping answered 200 to the mobile identity on the http lane with the declared Android User-Agent and hints sent, robots allowed, no identity_mismatch; no redirect to en.m.wikipedia.org was observed (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md D). Tests: contracts identityBundle.test.ts, bench pageOptions.test.ts (a responsive page sees Android, 412 CSS pixels and touch), api executionOptions.test.ts (stored on a crawl, its pages carry the identity).

scrape-execution.skip-tls-verification.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: by default a certificate that does not verify is failed/tls_error on both lanes with the error code in request_failed (also when robots.txt fails on it), never connection_error or policy_denied; `skipTlsVerification` relaxes verification for one local fetch and its robots.txt lookup through routes of its own, closed after it (the shared routes, the robots cache's own and the delivery worker keep verifying), the browser lane opens ignoreHTTPSErrors, and every result carries tls_verification_skipped and a tls_unverified warning; ApiEngineOptions.hosted (set by --hosted and the hosted MCP host) refuses it with HTTP 400 before any fetch. Live: self-signed.badssl.com and expired.badssl.com are failed/tls_error with DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT and CERT_HAS_EXPIRED by default, answer HTTP 200 through the proxy tunnel under the option with the warning, the event and a real robots verdict (the heading-only pages are empty_unverified by the error model), and a hosted API refuses the option by name (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md E-A to E-E). Tests: bench tlsVerification.test.ts (openssl self-signed server, both lanes), http-core resilient.test.ts, api executionOptions.test.ts.

scrape-execution.fast-mode.evidence: a436397, 4b7ce20: `fastMode` on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc) keeps the http rung alone, refused by name for a URL the channel policy binds to the browser lane; the ladder audit opens with ladder_channels_filtered { reason: fastMode, dropped }, the http rung's verdict is the answer, and a scrape whose http rung asked for the browser rung carries agentHints naming fastMode. Live: quotes.toscrape.com/js/ is failed/empty_unverified on the http rung alone with browserMs 0, the filtered event and the hint, and quotes.toscrape.com/ is success with the ten quotes on the http rung alone (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md F). Tests: api executionOptions.test.ts (counting browser seam, batch, browser_only refusal), contracts api.test.ts, mcp tools.test.ts, contracts firecrawl.test.ts.

scrape-execution.block-ads.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: `blockAds` (default true) on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc); the local browser lane aborts, before any connection, requests to a bundled list of 53 reviewed ad-serving hosts (adHosts.ts, host or dot-suffix) and records ads_blocked { count, hosts }; the hosted browser keeps its allowlist whatever the option says. Live, local fixture: a script-written page naming pagead2.googlesyndication.com and ad.doubleclick.net gets ads_blocked count 2 with both hosts and Markdown without the ad container; the false case ran against loopback stand-ins only, both of which were loaded (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md G). No frozen test-set row names the feature. Tests: bench blockAds.test.ts (adHosts seam, both cases).

scrape-formats.block-ads.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60: ExtractorOptions.blockAds (default true) switches the extractor's ad-container and cookie-banner pruning, which was always on, so default Markdown and html are unchanged (EXTRACTOR_VERSION stays extract-tf/5, pinned by version.test.ts) and `blockAds: false` keeps ads and cookie banners in markdown and html on every lane; rawHtml is always the page as received. Live, local fixture: with the default neither markdown nor html contains the ad container and with false both do (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md G). Tests: extract-tf extract.test.ts and markdown.test.ts (default removes, false keeps, a `download` class is never pruned), bench blockAds.test.ts.
